name: produktly
label: Produktly
description: Onboarding, in-app announcements, feedback collection and NPS for SaaS products.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: In Produktly, open Settings → API keys, click Generate API Key and copy it.

list_changelogs.label: List Changelogs
list_changelogs.description: List all changelogs in your Produktly account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of changelogs to return (1-100, default 50).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of changelogs to skip for pagination (default 0).

list_changelogs.beforeRequest:
request.query = { limit: request.query.limit ?? '50', offset: request.query.offset ?? '0', ...request.query };
return request;
list_changelogs.afterResponse: return response.data.map((changelog) => ({ changelog_id: changelog.id, changelog_name: changelog.name, changelog_active: changelog.active, changelog_created_at: changelog.createdAt }));

list_changelog_posts.label: List Changelog Posts
list_changelog_posts.description: List all posts within a specific changelog.

changelog.label: Changelog
changelog.description: The changelog the post belongs to.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (1-100, default 50).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of posts to skip for pagination (default 0).

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2024-01-01) to filter posts from.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2024-12-31) to filter posts up to.

list_changelog_posts.beforeRequest:
request.query = { limit: request.query.limit ?? '50', offset: request.query.offset ?? '0', ...request.query };
return request;
list_changelog_posts.afterResponse: return response.data.map((post) => ({ post_id: post.id, changelog_id: inputs.changelog, post_title: post.title, post_description: post.description, post_date: post.date, post_active: post.active, post_tags: post.tags.map((t) => t.name).join(', ') }));

create_changelog_post.label: Create Changelog Post
create_changelog_post.description: Publish a new post inside a changelog. Visible to your users once active.

changelog.label: Changelog
changelog.description: The changelog the post belongs to.

title.label: Title
title.description: The headline shown to users (e.g. "New: Dark mode is here").

description.label: Description
description.description: The body of the post. Supports plain text or HTML.

date.label: Date
date.description: Optional release date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-12-15). Defaults to today.

active.label: Active
active.description: If enabled, the post is visible to your users immediately.

tag_names.label: Tag Names
tag_names.description: Optional list of tag names to attach. Must match existing tags (use "List Tags" to find them).

create_changelog_post.afterResponse: return { post_id: response.id, post_title: response.title, post_description: response.description, post_date: response.date, post_active: response.active, post_tags: response.tags.map((t) => t.name).join(', ') };

update_changelog_post.label: Update Changelog Post
update_changelog_post.description: Edit an existing changelog post — change its title, body, tags or visibility.

changelog.label: Changelog
changelog.description: The changelog the post belongs to.

post_id.label: Post ID
post_id.description: The ID of the post to update. Use "List Changelog Posts" to find it.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title for the post. Leave empty to keep the current one.

description.label: Description
description.description: New body for the post. Leave empty to keep the current one.

date.label: Date
date.description: New release date in ISO 8601 format. Leave empty to keep the current one.

active.label: Active
active.description: Toggle whether the post is visible to users.

tag_names.label: Tag Names
tag_names.description: Replace the list of tags on the post. Must match existing tags (use "List Tags" to find them).

update_changelog_post.afterResponse: return { post_id: response.id, post_title: response.title, post_description: response.description, post_date: response.date, post_active: response.active, post_tags: response.tags.map((t) => t.name).join(', ') };

list_feedback_responses.label: List Feedback Responses
list_feedback_responses.description: List the user responses submitted through a feedback widget.

widget.label: Feedback Widget
widget.description: The feedback widget to read responses from.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of responses to return (1-100, default 50).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of responses to skip for pagination (default 0).

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date to filter responses from (e.g. 2024-01-01).

list_roadmaps.label: List Roadmaps
list_roadmaps.description: List all public roadmaps in your Produktly account.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of roadmaps to return (1-100, default 50).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of roadmaps to skip for pagination (default 0).

list_roadmaps.beforeRequest:
request.query = { limit: request.query.limit ?? '50', offset: request.query.offset ?? '0', ...request.query };
return request;
list_roadmaps.afterResponse: return response.data.map((roadmap) => ({ roadmap_id: roadmap.id, roadmap_name: roadmap.name, roadmap_public_name: roadmap.publicName, roadmap_active: roadmap.active, roadmap_custom_domain: roadmap.customDomain, roadmap_public_id: roadmap.publicId, roadmap_section_count: roadmap.sections.length, roadmap_item_count: roadmap.sections.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.items.length, 0) }));

get_roadmap.label: Get Roadmap
get_roadmap.description: Get a single roadmap with its sections, items, tags and vote counts.
get_roadmap.afterResponse:
const items = response.sections.flatMap((section) => section.items.map((item) => ({ roadmap_id: response.id, section_id: section.id, section_name: section.name, item_id: item.id, item_name: item.name, item_description: item.description, item_votes: item.votesCount, item_updated_at: item.updatedAt, item_tag: item.tag ? item.tag.name : null })));
return { roadmap_id: response.id, roadmap_name: response.name, roadmap_public_name: response.publicName, roadmap_active: response.active, roadmap_custom_domain: response.customDomain, roadmap_public_id: response.publicId, section_count: response.sections.length, item_count: items.length, items };

get_nps_score.label: Get NPS Score
get_nps_score.description: Get the current Net Promoter Score (NPS) for a widget, broken down into promoters, passives and detractors.

widget.label: NPS Widget
widget.description: The NPS widget to get the score for.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date to limit the score to responses from this date onward (e.g. 2024-01-01).

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date to limit the score to responses up to this date (e.g. 2024-12-31).

get_nps_score.afterResponse: return { widget_id: inputs.widget, nps_score: response.npsScore, total_responses: response.totalResponses, promoters_count: response.promoters.count, promoters_percentage: response.promoters.percentage, passives_count: response.passives.count, passives_percentage: response.passives.percentage, detractors_count: response.detractors.count, detractors_percentage: response.detractors.percentage };

get_company_stats.label: Get Company Stats
get_company_stats.description: Get a company-wide statistics summary across all your Produktly features.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date for the start of the period (e.g. 2024-01-01).

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date for the end of the period (e.g. 2024-12-31).

get_company_stats.afterResponse: return { period_start: response.period.start, period_end: response.period.end, period_days: response.period.days, period_granularity: response.period.granularity, previous_period_start: response.previousPeriod.start, previous_period_end: response.previousPeriod.end, features: response.features.map((f) => ({ feature_type: f.type, feature_label: f.label, primary_label: f.primary.label, primary_count: f.primary.count, primary_previous_count: f.primary.previousCount, primary_change_pct: f.primary.changePct, secondary_label: f.secondary.label, secondary_value: f.secondary.value, secondary_previous_value: f.secondary.previousValue, secondary_change_pp: f.secondary.changePp })) };

get_widget_stats.label: Get Widget Stats
get_widget_stats.description: Get event and unique-user statistics for a specific entity type (e.g. all changelogs, all NPS widgets).

entity_type.label: Entity Type
entity_type.description: The Produktly feature to get stats for.

entity_id.label: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Optional. Filter stats to a single entity of the chosen type (e.g. a specific changelog ID).

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date for the start of the period (e.g. 2024-01-01).

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date for the end of the period (e.g. 2024-12-31).

get_widget_stats.afterResponse: return { entity_type: response.entityType, period_start: response.period.start, period_end: response.period.end, widget_count: response.widgets.length, widgets: response.widgets.map((w) => ({ entity_id: w.entityId, name: w.name, archived_at: w.archivedAt, total_events: w.totalEvents, total_unique_users: w.totalUniqueUsers, event_breakdown: Object.entries(w.events).map(([eventName, stats]) => `${eventName}: ${stats.count} (${stats.uniqueUsers} unique)`).join(' | ') })) };
